address: Jiva Hill Resort, Route d'Harée, Crozet, 01170, France
bio: In Sanskrit, jiva means life, giving the visitor a foretaste of what to expect in this luxurious, understated resort. The restaurant specialises in exquisitely balanced French cuisine, using the best, fresh seasonal produce. Diners will enjoy a breathtaking view over Mont Blanc, whenever the weather permits, from the panoramic terrace....
